name: io.github.Grubbomatic/crawl-readiness
description: Check what AI crawlers may read and what a page permits, generate llms.txt and schema.

environmentVariables.name: CRAWL_READINESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Free API key from https://www.crawlreadiness.com/dashboard. The four audit tools and check_permission work without it; the three generators and get_monitor_trend need it.

environmentVariables.name: CRAWL_READINESS_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Only useful for testing against a preview deployment; defaults to https://www.crawlreadiness.com.
